# natural-writing-ja

> Japanese prose norm for writing explanatory text that does not read as machine-generated. Built on one diagnostic axis (does a sentence update the situation or the document?) plus register purity, sentence-beat and 体言止め/反問 rules calibrated against 937 sentences of human technical writing. Use when drafting or revising Japanese articles, docs, or long-form explanations, especially after an LLM produced the draft. For English use natural-writing-en; for scoring a draft use ai-index.

## Install

### APM (recommended)

```bash
apm install mizchi/skills/natural-writing-ja
```

Or declare it in `apm.yml` for a reproducible setup:

```yaml
dependencies:
  apm:
    - mizchi/skills/natural-writing-ja
```

then run `apm install`.
